top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in August of 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational Policies did state if operation will administer unassigned epinephrine auto injectors.
